5. Construction 6. Tests 6.1 Classification

of Tests

6.1 .l Type test - The procedures for type approval shall be in accordance with Recommendations for type approval and sampling procedures for electronic components. of type tests and requirements shall be in accordance with Table 5.

IS : 2612-I 965 The sequence

6.1 .I .l Number of samples - The manufacturer shall submit 24 specimens in any one temperature coefficient in each size of component for which approval is desired or a minimum of 28 specimens if approval for only one temperature coefficient in a size is desired, in accordance with Table 3. For each additional temperature coefficient in a size 8 more specimens shall be submitted for testing in Groups 3 and 5. The specimens shall be of the highest capacitance value-and closest tolerance in each temperature coefficient.
